name: Jack Stanley
original_name: ジャック・スタンリー
source:
A security assistance officer from the U.S. Embassy. He joins [url=/c73541]Kano[/url] during his investigation of the kidnapping case.

[spoiler]In actuality, Stanley is a CIA agent attempting to uncover and take down [url=/c74615]Alphard[/url] as revenge for his brother's death.[/spoiler]
